title: Implement authorized Plant card/current state and history query services
verify: Plant card/current state and history reads resolve ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant before returning entries.
Archived Plant history remains retained and authorized while normal operations stay blocked.
evidence_required: Integration tests for unauthorized, revoked-grant, archived-normal-flow, and authorized archived-history reads.
Redaction evidence for bounded history summary fields.
constraints: History reads are actor/Farm/Plant scoped and exclude unauthorized Plants.
Summary fields are bounded and redacted; raw UI markdown, raw chat, hidden reasoning, secrets, and auth material are excluded.
invariants: Revoked PlantAccessGrant blocks future normal retrieval without deleting retained history/audit/evidence.
Frontend visibility is presentation only and cannot authorize history access.
verification_targets: Authorized archived history access with normal operation exclusion.
